label: pre_grid_era_b_v4
purpose: pre-grid baseline for RUN-A-STAR-3 (era B, tools-on), re-cut on the RECONCILED total after RUN-A-STAR-2 was refused at gate 2 with zero requests sent. Two faults are fixed, not papered over: (1) baseline-3 described 19 rows files while 25 exist (145 rows billed after its as_of); (2) the launcher's attribution rule silently unbilled kind=turn-initial, so 30 of those 145 were invisible to the delta check and no honest ledger state could satisfy it.
as_of_meaning: rows files stamped after this instant belong to the delta window; the figures below already include every row billed up to it (all 25 files, 1321 rows, nothing on disk later than 2026-10-27T08:40:49Z)
source_ledger_note: REGENERATED ARTEFACT, not the file baseline-3 pointed at: the old measure/REQUEST-LEDGER.json (sha 63e3a156..., 1176/3144) was replaced by request_ledger.py's own build_report at 2026-10-27T20:53:48Z. The new file carries no hand-edited number: its sha and this as_of are stated above, and its figures are the same 1321/2999 recorded here.
recomputed_by: python3 -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"tools"); import request_ledger as rl; rl.build_report(sorted(glob.glob("measure/rows-*.jsonl")),4320,0,0)' -> requests 1321 / remaining 2999 over 25 files
rule: one request per row that IS one wire request: kind in {turn, tool-followup, turn-initial, digest} count (each traced to its make_row call site in run_longrun.py); billed=false, followup_suppressed, served_from=='prompt' do not; a row with NO kind is counted and flagged assumed_billed; an UNRECOGNISED non-empty kind is refused (UnrecognisedKind), never silently billed or unbilled
rule_implementation: ONE function: request_ledger.row_bills() (request_ledger.py). run_a_star._row_counts() imports and delegates to it, so the recount and the attribution cannot disagree. Guarded by experiments/ptr-engine/tests/test_ledger_kind_rule.py.

kind_rule_evidence.turn-initial: run_longrun.py:2726-2729 make_row(..., 'turn-initial', ...) -- the INITIAL send's own row; run_longrun.py:2672 'k>=1 follow-ups means k+1 requests'
kind_rule_evidence.(no kind): legacy schema: counted + flagged assumed_billed (232 rows)
kind_rule_evidence.tool_call: NOT a kind: no make_row site passes it; 'tool_calls' is a row FIELD (run_longrun.py:2692) describing calls the turn row already bills
kind_rule_evidence.unknown kind: REFUSED (UnrecognisedKind) -- neither billed nor silently unbilled

reconciliation.check: for every rows file, recount == attribution (request_ledger.scan_file vs sum(run_a_star._row_counts))

fixture_proofs.rename_to_unknown_kind: both sides REFUSE (RowsUnreadable / SystemExit); exit 5, nothing counted

rows_inventory_meaning: line counts, sha256 and the per-kind census of every rows file this baseline read; a file whose kinds leave {turn, tool-followup, turn-initial, digest, (no kind)} now makes the ledger refuse

supersedes.label: pre_grid_era_b_v3
why_it_was_wrong: STALE FILE: baseline-3 froze 19 rows files / 1176 rows at as_of 2026-10-26T22:33:00Z. Six more files (145 rows) were billed afterwards -- 3x rows-cell-lease-reopen (7+30+56), rows-cell-pointer-stable-20261027T004027Z (25), rows-cell-transcript-compact-20261027T004155Z (14), rows-cell-transcript-grow-20261027T004129Z (13) -- so 1176 stopped describing the corpus while the ledger kept rebuilding from all of it.

ATTRIBUTION RULE OMITTED turn-initial: run_a_star._row_counts() billed only {turn, tool-followup} and returned False for any other kind, so 30 real requests (2+7+13+6+1+1 across the six new files) never entered attributed_delta. With a correct live ledger the check read RECONCILE baseline=1176 attributed_delta=115 live=1321 explained=1291 gap=30 -> exit 1. No honest ledger state satisfied it.
CONSEQUENCE: RUN-A-STAR-2 refused before cell 1 with 0 requests sent, blocking a 16-cell / ~1056-request grid.
supersedes.not_mutated: baseline-3 is untouched and remains reachable at its path and sha above

grid_fit.note: the grid was NOT re-shaped to meet a ledger; the ledger was re-derived to describe the work. If the arithmetic had failed, the answer was a report, not a smaller grid

how_to_compute_delta.launcher: run_a_star.py::remaining_basis() -> attributed_delta() uses _row_counts, which is request_ledger.row_bills: the same function the recount uses
how_to_compute_delta.next_cell: a cell billed after as_of moves the live ledger and the delta by the same row count
